subject: settlement amount doesn't match my records
body: The amount settled on 15th Sept doesn't tally with what I calculated from my order list for that period, its short by exactly 7400 rupees. I went back and this seems to match a refund I processed a few days ago for an order that was originally paid back in early August and had already been settled long before. Why is a refund from an old, already-settled order being taken out of an unrelated settlement batch weeks later? Please explain the logic here, my accountant is asking me to reconcile this.
